name: cryptovault
description: Group 18 - Secure Cloud File Sharing Using Hybrid Cryptography (MERN demo): base AES-ECC (Rehman et al. 2021) vs proposed authenticated hybrid envelope (AES-256-GCM + ECDH P-256 + ECDSA P-256)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
